purpose: Prevent manual-capture timing and finite-feed-window selection bias in D20-06/D20-11/D20-03 prospective evidence.

canonicalPrimaryClock.rule: A primary social snapshot is eligible only when captured inside an actually executed Room13 scheduled research run at its fixed :10 slot while that automation is enabled by the rotation controller.
canonicalPrimaryClock.noAssumedHourlyContinuity: The controller may rotate Room13 off. Disabled/missed hours are not silently filled and are marked NO_SCHEDULED_CAPTURE / UNKNOWN coverage.
canonicalPrimaryClock.manualCaptureRole: User-triggered/manual captures may test source/parser/version logic and may form SECONDARY_PROSPECTIVE_PROCESS samples, but do not count toward primary L4 sample-size gates.

feedCoverage.finiteWindowRisk: Feed exposes only a finite latest-entry window; absence between snapshots cannot be treated as zero posts without continuity evidence.
feedCoverage.overlapRule: For consecutive primary snapshots, require at least one stable article ID overlap OR another independently frozen continuity proof. If no overlap, interval completeness = UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE.
feedCoverage.includeAllFirstObserved: Every newly first-observed entry in a valid primary snapshot is included irrespective of topic, stance, engagement or later outcome.

articleCapture.versionRule: Append-only article snapshots; no historical backfill before first observation.
articleCapture.zeroEngagementRule: Zero-reply/zero-adoption parents remain in the cohort.

moduleRules.D20-03: Only qualifying explicit-confidence posts first observed in a valid primary snapshot after its current taxonomy effective time count toward primary L4.
moduleRules.D20-06: Aggregate social-herding parents from valid primary snapshots only; no named-user psychology/influence profile.
moduleRules.D20-11: Aggregate narrative-diffusion parents from valid primary snapshots only; event/news/theme/attention controls remain mandatory.

priorManualParent.reason: Captured prospectively after preregistration but at an ad hoc manual time before the deterministic sampling-clock contract was frozen.
